car-racer.name: Toy racer
good: Chunky, friendly racer with a clear nose, cockpit bump and big tyres.
Four separate wheels, each named wheel, with the axle running side to side so they can spin.
Sits on the ground facing forward, at about car size.
off: Wheel positions were placed by eye from the body shape, so they may sit a little off the real axles.
One plain tan colour, with no number plate or stripes.

car-toddler.name: Chunky toddler car
good: Soft, rounded toy shape that suits a storybook garage.
Four separate wheels that can spin.
off: The body is a flat slab with a window hole, more of a toy block than a car.
Wheels are huge for the body and were placed by eye.

car-pickup.name: Toy pickup truck
good: Reads clearly as a pickup, with a cab and an open bed.
Four separate wheels that can spin.
off: The wheels are tiny compared with the body, so it looks like it is gliding.
Wheel positions were placed by eye.
The original has a print-in-place tailgate that is not kept.

car-sedan.name: Red sedan
good: Wheels were found inside the file automatically, so they sit exactly right and can spin.
off: Very simple flat panels with no real detail.
Lighter than the usual size for a car, so it can take more detail.

car-wedge.name: Wedge toy car
off: The wheels are fused to the body, so they cannot spin and the car cannot be used for driving as it is.
To use it, the wheels would need to be cut out and rebuilt.

car-concept.name: Concept sports car
good: The most detailed and exciting shape of the set.
off: The wheels are fused to the body, so they cannot spin.
The source is very heavy and was shrunk a long way, which softens the detail.
The Printables picture is marked as AI-generated, so treat the design as inspiration.
